analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI recovery + MACD improvement + Higher Low
analysis.reason: RSI가 44.9에서 61.6으로 상승하며 과매도 구간을 탈출했고, MACD 히스토그램도 -3.3582에서 -0.8920으로 개선되었습니다. 또한 5일 저가($174.14)가 20일 저가($174.14)보다 높게 형성되며 Higher Low 패턴을 확인했습니다. 이 모든 지표가 상승 추세를 지지합니다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.9 to 61.6, exiting oversold territory, and the MACD histogram improved from -3.3582 to -0.8920. Additionally, the 5-day low ($174.14) formed higher than the 20-day low ($174.14), confirming a Higher Low pattern. All these indicators support an uptrend.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($201.84) vs SMA5/20/50 ($187.82/$192.38/$182.18) — trading above short-term and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($147.88/$133.05) — maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (88.1%) + current price approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.9→61.6) — exiting oversold and entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.3582→-0.8920) — improving from a bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $210.65) — approaching the upper band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($181.00) — based on 20-day low and SMA50.
· Swing resistance ($209.50) — approaching 5-day high and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low confirmed) — entering a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x) — normal level, supporting price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — considering entry for buy.
